title: Paint tools: hold Alt for a colour picker (eyedropper)
description: Fabio 2026-09-17: in the IMAGE history workspace, while a Paint tool is active, holding Alt temporarily turns the cursor into a colour picker; clicking samples the canvas colour into the paint colour, releasing Alt returns to painting. Reuse what MPI-771 built: js/utils/colourKeyMask.js readImagePixels / cornerColour and the native EyeDropper pattern in MpiToolOptionsMaskColour. Paint colour lives in toolSettings.paint.color. Alt must go through Hotkeys.bind + hotkeyRegistry.js (no raw keydown).
